entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Despite Ancient Apparition's fragileness, he can easily harass Luna on lane with Chilling Touch due to it's high range and damage. This can get even worse if Ancient Apparition buys Aghanim's Scepter and combines it with items that can give him bonus attack damage and attack speed.
Chilling Touch combined with Ice Vortex can make it difficult for Luna to escape from Cold Feet
Ice Blast can nullify any healing Luna receives and any attempt for her to save herself with Satanic, even through Black King Bar.
For the same reasons, Ancient Apparition makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Quill Spray and Bristleback harass Luna more efficiently than she does with Lucent Beam.
Bristleback helps return a lot of damage to Luna’s team if she uses her nukes on him and he has his back to her, and her only way to counter this is by buying Silver Edge.
Viscous Nasal Goo and Warpath are enough to outrun a speedy Luna.
Bristleback tends to be a frequent carrier of Crimson Guard and Eternal Shroud, which are good protection from Moon Glaives and Eclipse.
For the same reasons, Bristleback makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Jakiro
lines: Even though Luna can easily kill Jakiro in few strikes, he can also do the same to her is she is not careful.
Dual Breath and Liquid Fire allow Jakiro to harass Luna more efficiently than she can harass Jakiro with her Lucent Beam.
Jakiro can save his allies from Luna during her attempts to use Eclipse by casting Ice Path on Luna.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Macropyre can deal pure damage-over-time and pierce spell immunity, which can make it very hard for Luna to be in teamfights without suffering too many damage.
For the same reasons, Jakiro makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Juggernaut
lines: Because of her low range, Luna cannot easily destroy Healing Ward.

Both Blade Fury and Omnislash are direct counters to Eclipse, offering Juggernaut spell immunity and invulnerabilty. Therefore, Luna will need assistance in taking down Juggernaut as going solo will not be successful.

entries.name: Lina
lines: Lina has very high magic burst damage to use against the low-health-pool Luna. Laguna Blade can also be upgraded with Laguna Blade damage is Pure and pierces Spell Immunity to bypass Black King Bar, making Lina even more of a threat. Luna however, can easily counter this problem with Linken's Sphere, which is a common item for her.
For the same reasons, Lina makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Medusa
lines: Should Luna choose to buy Manta Style, Medusa will be able to kill illusions from them with Split Shot and Mjollnir, which is a common item on Medusa.
Mystic Snake allows Medusa to easily harass Luna and steal mana from her, preventing Luna from retaliating with Lucent Beam.
Medusa can survive Eclipse thanks to Mana Shield, which can cause Luna to struggle greatly in bursting down Medusa and force her to buy Diffusal Blade and it's upgrade Disperser.
Even with Black King Bar, Medusa's Stone Gaze will still be able to disable Luna, which could even discourage her from counter-initiating with Eclipse.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Even though Moon Glaives can bounce between Meepo and his clones, Meepo can tank Eclipse because of his clones.
Earthbind takes away Luna's mobility advantage.
Meepo can shutdown Luna's split-push ability with his global presence.

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Even though Luna can clear Phantom Lancer's illusions with Moon Glaives, Phantom Lancer can create too many illusions to tank Luna's Eclipse and for Luna to handle overall.
Doppelganger can be used to dodge a number of Lucent Beams during Eclipse.
Phantom Lancer can chase Luna effectively regardless of her high movement speed thanks to Phantom Rush and Spirit Lance.
Luna's low health pool is easily exploited by the sheer damage output from Phantom Lancer's illusions. Additionally, Phantom Lancer can often create more illusions for Luna to handle.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Even with Black King Bar, Pudge's Meat Hook and Dismember can still disable Luna for a fairly long time.

Many stacks of Flesh Heap will make it difficult for Luna to burst down Pudge with Eclipse. Aghanim's Shard upgraded Dismember can also allow Pudge to save an allied hero from being killed by Eclipse.
Bear in mind, however, that Luna can cancel Dismember if some of her allies are targets. Which may force Pudge to buy Black King Bar earlier.

entries.name: Rubick
lines: Telekinesis allows Rubick and his team to coordinate a gank on Luna early on. And just like Aghanim's Shard upgraded Dismember, Aghanim's Shard upgraded Telekinesis can also allow Rubick to save an allied hero from being killed by Eclipse.
Fade Bolt allows Rubick to harass Luna on lane and weaken her attack damage early on.

Both, Lucent Beam and Eclipse are very useful for Rubick to steal with Spell Steal, Luna's only way to counter this is with Lunar Orbit. Rubick can also use them from further distances than Luna thanks to Arcane Supremacy that increases his cast range and when he gets Aghanim's Scepter.

entries.name: Sand King
lines: Burrowstrike allows Sand King to escape from Eclipse or to close the gap on Luna and finish her off.

Sand Storm allows Sand King to harass Luna more efficiently than she does with Lucent Beam, as it makes him invisible for it's duration and while in it, rendering him safe from both, Lucent Beam and Eclipse and forcing Luna to buy Dust of Appearance more often.
Caustic Finale allows Sand King to deal serious damage to both, Luna and her allies, which is especially hazardous in laning stage as Luna's attack range is short.
Epicenter combined with Burrowstrike and Sand Storm can often kill Luna before she can do anything because of her low health and strength gain.
Overall, Sand King forces Luna to play more defensively instead of offensively, and for the same reasons, Sand King makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Slark
lines: Shadow Dance prevents Luna from damaging Slark, and together with Silver Edge he can easily chase her or escape from her.
Luna has no way to escape from Pounce's leash, which is especially bad as she is not used to buying Wind Waker, which is the only way to escape from Pounce outside of Black King Bar.
For the same reasons, Slark makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Shadow Demon
lines: Demonic Purge takes off Luna's superior mobility, removing the need for chasing her and allowing your team to reposition in team fights or escape when at low HP. If Shadow Demon has Aghanim's Scepter it will also take away glaive bounces and extra damage from Luna's passive. And Luna's commonly items Manta Style and Black King Bar does not work dispell to Demonic Purge
Luna's illusions created by Disruption are very valuable with their Moon Glaives. These will effectively counter her pushing attempts and are painfully effective in team fights.
Disruption can be used to save an ally from Eclipse.
For the same reasons, Shadow Demon makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.

entries.name: Zeus
lines: Zeus's highly damaging nuke spells with low cooldowns is not something Luna can go against, though Luna can win against Zeus in late game.
Thundergod's Wrath can be used before a fight to harm Luna before she activates Black King Bar, reducing her survivability for that fight.
For the same reasons, Zeus makes a very powerful ally for Luna when they are in the same team.
Heroes that can keep Luna locked down for a long time can be a threat (she is very item and spell dependent): Faceless Void, Legion Commander, Doom.
Heroes that outrange Luna can be a problem for her: Drow Ranger, Sniper.
Other carries who can chase effectively despite Luna's high movement speed: Phantom Lancer, Slark, Holy Knight, or Phantom Assassin.

Heroes that create illusions: Spectre, Shadow Demon, Phantom Lancer, Naga Siren, Holy Knight, Terrorblade) or bring other units into the fight (such as Nature's Prophet, Lone Druid, Chen, Enchantress, Meepo and Arc Warden) can cause Eclipse to strike the illusions/summons unintentionally. However, in many cases Moon Glaives can resolve this issue and eliminate them before activating Eclipse, but that will require lots of farming for right-click items.

A couple of long-range heroes with excellent laning like Mirana, Lina, Necrophos, Death Prophet. The key to success is sticking together and attacking Luna whenever she enters the range, without even giving Luna a chance to retaliate. Multiple long-range heroes is a reason to pick another hero.
Every hero that can withstand or prevent Eclipse at level 7: Juggernaut, Riki, Clockwerk, Drow Ranger, Abaddon, Faceless Void, Weaver, Outworld Destroyer.
A couple of nukers and disablers on the same lane can finish a squishy Luna efficiently despite a teammate's assistance: Sven + Shadow Shaman.
Escape-type carries: Slark, Storm Spirit, Weaver.

All assassin-type carries in a one against one situation: Meepo, Phantom Assassin, Riki, Ursa. Luna's only chances are that she buys Ethereal Blade or Black King Bar to gain a slight edge against them, or both items if necessary.

Items which allow the enemy to go invisible, such as Glimmer Cape and Shadow Blade. Silver Edge will also disable Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing as an added effect. However, this problem can be partly solved with Dust of Appearance, but that will require of Luna to consume one item slot less. Luna's only proper solution to counter this problem is to buy Gleipnir that can be used to root multiple heroes at once in an area.

Black King Bar and other forms of Spell Immunity will block Luna's magical damage output. However, they will not block Luna's high physical damage, since Luna often goes for items that give her bonus attack damage and attack speed.
Vanguard and it's upgrades Abyssal Blade and Crimson Guard can greatly reduce damage from Moon Glaives.
Bloodthorn will render Luna helpless until she buys a dispelling item like Black King Bar, Manta Style, Satanic or Disperser.
Wind Waker can be used to both, dodge Eclipse and escape from Luna, and Luna's only way to counter this is by buying Nullifier.
Blade Mail can reflect Luna's damage burst against her. This problem however, can be solved by buying Black King Bar as damage return from Blade Mail cannot pierce spell immunity.

Heaven's Halberd disarms Luna, negating her physical damage and lifesteal from Satanic. As Luna is a ranged hero, the disarm is slightly more effective. However, she can still dispel it with Black King Bar or Manta Style.
Pipe of Insight, Eternal Shroud and Glimmer Cape will greatly weaken damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Scythe of Vyse can slow down Luna and prevent her from both, using abilities and items. And Luna's only way to counter this is by buying Linken's Sphere.
Lotus Orb can reflect Lucent Beam back at Luna if she impulsively tries to use it on a hero affected by it.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Although Anti-Mage can survive Luna's magical damage output with Counterspell, Luna's physical damage from Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can be fair enough to deal with him.

Reckless use of Blink will allow Luna Eclipse can finish off Anti-Mage from early-to-mid stages of the game until Anti-Mage gets Manta Style, Aghanim's Scepter that will give him access to Blink Fragment and Aghanim's Shard which will allow Counterspell to weaken enemy spell damage.
However, Luna needs to finish the match as quickly as possible, because Anti-Mage is a hero who has a big advantage in longer matches once he farms items he needs for teamfights.

entries.name: Arc Warden
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives allow her to clear Arc Warden's File:ArcWardenUltPng.jpeg Tempest Double.
Luna's short range and fast movement speed allow her to fight Arc Warden inside his Magnetic Field.

entries.name: Bane
lines: Though Bane's Enfeeble can weaken Luna's physical damage output, it still does not weaken her magical damage output (although it can still disable her cast range).
Without Black King Bar, Luna's Lucent Beam and 0.25 Eclipse Mini-stun talent for Eclipse can be used to disable Bane while he is channeling Fiend's Grip.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with 0.25 Eclipse Mini-stun can repetively stun Bane, and can even discourage him from even trying to use Fiend's Grip.
Smart and skilled Luna can buy Abyssal Blade to cancel Fiend's Grip even through Black King Bar in case of emergency. Forcing Bane to buy Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
lines: Even though Luna is the kind of hero that Bounty Hunter can handle due to Shadow Walk rendering him safe from Eclipse, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance, allowing her to provide vision on him to her team, and possibly, kill Bounty Hunter with Eclipse.

entries.name: Centaur Warrunner
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives will not trigger Retaliate if they hit some other target first. Also Luna commonly buys items that provide lifesteal such as Satanic, which lets her heal from the damage of Retaliate, meaning that Retaliate has limited effect against her.

Eclipse can be used to counter-initiate against Centaur Warrunner after he jumps in with Blink Dagger, and initiates with Hoof Stomp. But remember that Centaur Warrunner can resolve this problem by buying Hood of Defiance and it's upgrade Pipe of Insight to diminish its damage. Or Blade Mail to reflect the damage of the Eclipse back at Luna.
Luna also commonly buys Black King Bar, which will allow her to protect herself from both, Centaur Warrunner's abilities (except for the Retaliate), and damage reflect from Blade Mail.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Lucent Beam allows Luna to easily cancel Freezing Field.
Without Black King Bar protection, Lucent Beam and Eclipse can make a short work out of Crystal Maiden's abysmal health.
Skilled Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance, allowing her team to have a vision on Crystal Maiden while invisible and during channeling Freezing Field.

Even with Black King Bar, Luna can still inflict considerable damage on Crystal Maiden with her attacks, which get empowered with Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing, also smart and skilled Luna will buy Abyssal Blade to cancel Freezing Field even through Black King Bar in case of emergency. Forcing Crystal Maiden to buy Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Chen
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives combined with Lunar Blessing can easily kill Chen's creeps.

Eclipse can be used after Luna clears all of Chen's creeps to easily kill Chen or any of his allies before he can save them with Hand of God. This can get even worse if Luna buys Aghanim's Scepter. And Chen is not a hero that likes to buy Black King Bar to counter this problem.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: Luna's Lucent Beams and Eclipse will prevent Earthshaker from initiating or re-initiating.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be used to counter-initiate against Earthshaker after he uses Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Enchant Totem.

Skilled Luna can buy either {I|Gleipnir}} to prevent Earthshaker from using Blink Dagger, Silver Edge and Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Enchant Totem to either escape or counter-initiate. Luna can also buy Dust of Appearance to reveal Earthshaker whenever he tries to use Silver Edge.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: Though Enchantress's Untouchable can greatly reduce Luna's attack speed, and can go through any form of Spell Immunity, she has a pitiful HP so Lucent Beam and Eclipse can kill her very quickly.
Moon Glaives allows Luna to clear Enchantress's creeps very efficiently.

entries.name: Enigma
lines: Without Black King Bar, Luna will be able to cancel Enigma's Black Hole from safe distance with her Lucent Beam or with 0.25s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent and counter-initiate with Eclipse. This can get even worse for Enigma once Luna gets Aghanim's Scepter and combines it with 0.25s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent that will allow Luna to use Eclipse from safe distance.
If Luna chooses to use Eclipse in anticipation right after Enigma jumps in with Blink Dagger, she will be able to kill Enigma before he even gets a chance to use Black Hole.
Luna commonly buys Satanic, which can help her recover from Enigma's Black Hole in case she survives it.
Moon Glaives combined with Lunar Blessing can make a short work of Enigma's Eidolons before Luna uses Eclipse.

Bear in mind, however, that once Enigma gets Black King Bar, Luna will be out of solutions to cancel Black Hole, and going for Abyssal Blade on Luna can be risky due to Abyssal Blade's very short cast range.

entries.name: Io
lines: Lucent Beam and 0.25s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent for Eclipse can be used to cancel both, Tether and Relocate.
Luna's Moon Glaives and Eclipse abilities can make short work of Io and its tethered ally, particularly when upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: A well-timed Eclipse before a Duel usually prevents Legion Commander from winning Duels if Luna is the target. Luna can also buy Linken's Sphere to block Duel.
Meanwhile, when Luna is not a target, Eclipse and Lucent Beam can also help an ally win a Duel against Legion Commander.
Bear in mind, however, that skilled Legion Commander will always buy a Black King Bar to block Eclipse and Lucent Beam or Aghanim's Scepter to reduce their damage.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Although Lifestealer can avoid Eclipse with Rage and Infest, Luna's physical damage from Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can be enough to deal with him.
Manta Style is a common pick on Luna, which can help her dispel slows from Ghoul Frenzy and Open Wounds. In addition, Lifestealer is not good against illusions created by Manta Style.

Even though Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Infest can disarm Luna and allow Lifestealer to attack her from inside even if she is spell immune, Luna can easily counter this with Linken's Sphere, which is a common item on Luna.

entries.name: Magnus
lines: If Luna can use Eclipse in anticipation, Magnus will be killed before he can even manages to cast Reverse Polarity.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse is a very good counter-initiation tool against Magnus when he casts Reverse Polarity, granted as long as Luna can cast it from safe distance.

entries.name: Mirana
lines: Even though Luna is the kind of hero that Mirana can handle due to Moonlight Shadow rendering her safe from Eclipse with Moonlight Shadow, smart Luna can buy Dust of Appearance, allowing her to provide vision on her to her team, and possibly, kill Mirana.
Luna's high movement speed allows her to evade Sacred Arrow, giving Mirana difficulties in hitting her with it.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with Dust of Appearance allows Luna to cast it on a hero that is struck by Sacred Arrow and/or after Mirana jumps in with Leap.

entries.name: Muerta
lines: Lucent Beam can be used to harass Muerta in lane.
Luna's high movement speed can make it difficult for Muerta to hit her with Dead Shot and keep her trapped in The Calling.

Pierce the Veil will not save Muerta from Luna at all. Instead, it will sentence her to death as it will amplify the magical damage from both, Lucent Beam and Eclipse, potentially turning Muerta's most powerful ability against her. Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can also be used to counter-initiate against Muerta.

Luna can use Aghanim's Shard upgraded Moon Glaives to reduce all the damage Muerta inflicts on Luna while also damaging Muerta if she is too close to Luna. Bear in mind, however, Aghanim's Shard upgraded Moon Glaives cannot damage Muerta while she is under effects of Pierce the Veil.
As Luna naturally buys Black King Bar, she will be able to defend herself from Muerta's abilities. Luna can also buy Revenant's Brooch to attack Muerta even through Pierce the Veil.
Overall, most of the attempts for Muerta to gank and kill Luna will hurt Muerta more than Luna.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Guardian Angel does not offer protection from Eclipse, though it will negate damage from Moon Glaives.
Luna's high magical damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse can often finish allied heroes before Omniknight can save them with Purification.
Likewise, Luna's high physical damage from Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing is strong enough to counter debuff immunity from Repel.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can clear waves of Naga Siren's illusions from Mirror Image.
Once Naga Siren's illusions are cleared with Aghanim's Shard upgraded Moon Glaives, Eclipse can often finish off Naga Siren before she can escape with Song of the Siren.

A well-timed Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with 0.25 Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent can be casted at long range and allow Luna to burst down Naga Siren faster and repetively stun Naga Siren, preventing her from escaping with Song of the Siren and Town Portal Scroll without getting caught in it's range.

Luna is a natural Black King Bar wielder unlike Naga Siren who barely goes for it, which allows Luna to freely attack Naga Siren during Song of the Siren and potentially get rid of the most of the damage and crowd-control from Naga Siren.

entries.name: Nature's Prophet
lines: Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing help Luna quickly kill Nature's Prophet's treants.
Luna can easily cancel Teleportation with her Lucent Beam.
Even though Nature's Prophet can evade all of Luna's abilities with Shadow Blade, a smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance to provide vision on Shadow Fiend to her and her team.

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Even though Luna has a hard time laning against Necrophos, his Ghost Shroud won’t protect him in teamfights because it will increase the damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Luna is a natural Black King Bar wielder, and none of Necrophos's spells can bypass spell immunity outside of Heartstopper Aura.

entries.name: Nyx Assassin
lines: Even though Nyx Assassin can easily kill Luna with his high burst damage, Luna can also do the same to him if he is not careful.

Lucent Beam can deal a fair amount of damage to Nyx Assassin if he has no Spiked Carapace available to use. Although Luna should be patient using Lucent Beam on Nyx Assassin when he uses Spiked Carapace.

As Luna commonly buys Black King Bar, she can use it to freely attack Nyx Assassin whenever he tries to defend himself with Spiked Carapace during teamfights. Luna can also buy Eye of Skadi and Manta Style to survive Nyx Assassin's burst damage and distract him.
Though Vendetta can deal serious damage to Luna and avoid Eclipse, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance to provide vision on Nyx Assassin to her and her team.

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
lines: Even though Phantom Assassin can easily kill Luna in few strikes, Luna can also do the same to Phantom Assassin if she is not careful.

An ill-timed and ill-positioned Phantom Strike will make Phantom Assassin an easy target for counter-attack with Eclipse if she does not have Black King Bar available to use and if Phantom Assassin cannot kill Luna fast enough. This can be even better if Luna buys Aghanim's Scepter.
Moon Glaives can ignore Blur's evasion if Luna attacks an enemy near Phantom Assassin.
Luna can counter Blur's evasion by buying either Silver Edge, or Monkey King Bar, which are common items on Luna.

Luna just has to be careful about Fan of Knives from Aghanim's Shard and Coup de Grace, as Fan of Knives can disable Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing while Coup de Grace can deal serious damage to her even if she is spell immune, though this issue can be solved by buying Ethereal Blade, which is a situational item on Luna.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Luna can deal constant damage to Pugna through the low-cooldown Lucent Beam and her right clicks.
Life Drain will be always canceled by Lucent Beam if Pugna does not have Black King Bar.
Decrepify can be suicide against Luna due to Lucent Beam and Eclipse.

Nether Ward is rather weak against Luna because unlike other heroes who rely on magical damage to damage or kill enemies, yet their ablities have very high mana costs, Luna does not have abilities that cost a lot of mana and Luna mostly uses her abilities to initiate a teamfight or to finish off fleeing enemy heroes.
Luna is a common Black King Bar carrier, which allows her to protect herself against Pugna's only-magical damage output.

entries.name: Queen of Pain
lines: Aggressively blinking is not going to end well against Luna, because Queen of Pain will be an easy target for Lucent Beam & Eclipse.
Queen of Pain's HP is abysmal, so Luna can quickly kill Queen of Pain as soon as she initiates with Blink.

entries.name: Riki
lines: Luna can push very fast with Moon Glaives, which is something Riki cannot deal with well.
Luna is naturally very fast, making it hard for Riki to trap her in Smoke Cloud.
Even though Riki can evade Eclipse with his invisibility, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance, providing vision on Riki to her allies and herself.

entries.name: Shadow Fiend
lines: Lucent Beam and Eclipse with ministun talent can be used to cancel Requiem of Souls if Shadow Fiend does not have Black King Bar. Likewise, since Shadow Fiend is prone to buying Blink Dagger, an ill-timed Blink Dagger can give Luna a free chance to counter-initiate with Eclipse.

Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing allow Luna to outfarm Shadow Fiend in lane and the high physical damage output they provide her can also help her deal with Shadow Fiend even when he buys Black King Bar in late game.

A well timed Eclipse will burst and kill Shadow Fiend before he even either initiates or gets a chance to retaliate, especially when equipped with Aghanim's Scepter and Ethereal Blade, this could become even worse for Shadow Fiend if he does not have Black King Bar. But bear in mind however, that smart and skilled Shadow Fiend can buy Wind Waker to counter this issue.
Even though Shadow Fiend can evade all of Luna's abilities with Shadow Blade, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance to provide vision on Shadow Fiend to her and her team.

entries.name: Shadow Shaman
lines: Luna's high magical damage burst from Lucent Beam and Eclipse can take advantage of Shadow Shaman's low health and strength gain.
Without Black King Bar, Luna's Lucent Beam and 0.25 Eclipse Mini-stun talent for Eclipse can be used to disable Shadow Shaman while he is channeling Shackles.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with 0.25 Eclipse Mini-stun can repetively stun Shadow Shaman, and can even discourage him from even trying to use Shackles.
Luna is a natural Black King Bar wielder, and almost none of Shadow Shaman's spells can bypass spell immunity, except for Mass Serpent Ward.

Bear in mind, however, that if Shadow Shaman gets a jump on Luna first, he will be able to use Hex to disable Luna and burst her down before she can use Black King Bar, Lucent Beam or Eclipse. In addition, Moon Glaives cannot bounce on Mass Serpent Wards at all.

entries.name: Spirit Breaker
lines: If Luna chooses to use Eclipse in anticipation right before Spirit Breaker gets to her with Charge of Darkness, she will be able to kill Spirit Breaker before he will be able to kill her as Spirit Breaker's attack speed is rather low.
Meanwhile, when Spirit Breaker is focusing on any of Luna's allies with Charge of Darkness, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be used to counter-initate against Spirit Breaker.

Aghanim's Shard upgraded Moon Glaives allows Luna to reduce damage from Greater Bash and Nether Strike inflicts on her, and damage Spirit Breaker whenever he is close to her, even while he is invisible.

Lucent Beam can be used to cancel Spirit Breaker's Charge of Darkness under the condition that Luna is able to cast it on time. Lucent Beam can also be used to cancel Nether Strike. But bear in mind, however, that Spirit Breaker can counter this with Planar Pocket from Aghanim's Shard which can be used to reflect Lucent Beam back at Luna.
If Luna buys Linken's Sphere, it will become nearly impossible for Spirit Breaker to reach Luna unless some of Spirit Breaker's allies can pop it and put it on a cooldown.

Even though Spirit Breaker can evade all of Luna's abilities with Shadow Blade, smart Luna will always buy Dust of Appearance to provide vision on Spirit Breaker to her and her team. Luna can also buy Gleipnir to counter Spirit Breaker's Charge of Darkness and Shadow Blade combo.

entries.name: Terrorblade
lines: If carefully timed, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with 0.2s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent can quickly finish off Terrorblade before he can get a chance to save himself with Sunder due to its high magical damage as long as Terrorblade has no Black King Bar.

Moon Glaives allows Luna to clear Terrorblade's illusions from both, Conjure Image and Manta Style, this can be particularly advantegous for Luna if she has Manta Style. Just bear in mind, however, that Reflection can be used to turn Moon Glaives against Luna during laning phase.
Luna very often builds Satanic and Black King Bar, which allows it either to protect herself from Sunder or nullify it's effects.
Luna can also buy Monkey King Bar to help her deal with Terrorblade's high armor, which is a common item on Luna.

entries.name: Tidehunter
lines: Luna often builds Black King Bar, and none of Tidehunter's spells can bypass spell immunity.

Though Anchor Smash can weaken Luna's physical damage, it does not weaken her magical damage, which means that Lucent Beam and Eclipse deal a lot of magic damage in the early and mid-game, which can bypass Tidehunter's Kraken Shell.

entries.name: Tinker
lines: Even though Luna has a hard time laning against Tinker because of Heat-Seeking Missile and Laser, she can win against him in late game once she buys Black King Bar, as none of Tinker's spells can bypass spell immunity.

Lucent Beam and 0.25 Eclipse Lucent Mini-stun talent for Eclipse can be used to cancel Rearm and prevent Tinker's escape attempts with Boots of Travel. Luna can also use Lucent Beam and Eclipse if she is blinded with Laser.

An ill-timed and ill-positioned Blink Dagger will make Tinker a very easy target for Luna's Eclipse that can quickly tear him to shreds. This can get even better if Luna buys Aghanim's Scepter and combines it with 0.25 Eclipse Lucent Mini-stun talent for Eclipse.

However, Luna needs to approach Tinker carefully, as Tinker is a natural Scythe of Vyse wielder, and if he gets a jump on Luna first, he will be able to use it to disable and burst down Luna before she can use Black King Bar, Lucent Beam or Eclipse.

entries.name: Underlord
lines: Lunar Blessing gives allies bonus damage and armor required to endure against Atrophy Aura early on.

Eclipse can be devastating for Underlord's team when they're grouped up for Fiend's Gate, it can also be used to intercept arrivals with Fiend's Gate. And Pit of Malice does not prevent Luna to use it.
To make things even better, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can finish off Underlord or any of his teammates escape attempts with Fiend's Gate if timed correctly.

entries.name: Undying
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can help her destroy Tombstone easily, and this becomes more effective if Luna is equipped with Manta Style.
Spell Immunity of Zombies from Tombstone is a total disadvantage against Luna because Eclipse will strike only Undying, which can turn Undying's own ability against him.

Though Undying often builds Blade Mail which can turn Luna's burst damage against her, Luna often builds Black King Bar which will allow her to attack Undying freely because Blade Mail cannot pierce spell immunity.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Even though Luna has a hard time laning against Viper due to Nethertoxin being able to disable Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing, Luna can take out Viper once she builds either Black King Bar or Silver Edge which will allow her to attack Viper freely.
Eclipse can often finish off Viper from early-to-mid stages of the game before he can retaliate as Corrosive Skin gives little magic resistance to him early on.
Manta Style is an item that Luna commonly buys in most of the games, which lets her disjoint Viper Strike. Additionally, illusions from Manta Style can make Viper waste time attacking them.

entries.name: Visage
lines: Moon Glaives is very effective against Visage because not only it can easily destroy Visage's Familiars, but can also remove one instance of Gravekeeper's Cloak upon each hit to Visage, leaving him susceptible to damage.
Once Visage's Familiars are picked off and all instances of Gravekeeper's Cloak are removed, Luna will be able to easily kill Visage with Eclipse.

entries.name: Winter Wyvern
lines: Cold Embrace is no salvation against Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Moon Glaives will not hit a hero affected by Winter's Curse, making it weak against allies, but strong versus enemies.
Luna has better night vision provided by Lunar Blessing than Winter Wyvern when affected by Arctic Burn.

entries.name: Wraith King
lines: Even though Wraith King can easily get a chance to retaliate with Reincarnation after Luna uses Eclipse against him, smart Luna can also turn Reincarnation against him by using Eclipse right after Reincarnation triggers and gets on cooldown, giving Luna an element of surprise she can use against Wraith King.
Moon Glaives can be used to clear the waves of Wraith King's skeleton warriors summoned from Vampiric Spirit.
Heroes who are melee but cannot fight back against Eclipse will really struggle with Luna: Monkey King, Alchemist, Timbersaw.
Though Luna isn’t a dedicated chaser, she’s rather good at finishing off low HP heroes thanks to her high movement speed and incredible range on Lucent Beam.

Illusions and summons are double-edge sword type of matchup for Luna. On one hand, they can tank damage from Eclipse, but on the other hand, she can easily clear them before Eclipse with Moon Glaives. Examples include Spectre, Shadow Demon, Phantom Lancer, Naga Siren, Holy Knight, Terrorblade) or bring other units into the fight (such as Nature's Prophet, Lone Druid, Chen, Enchantress, Meepo and Arc Warden).

Luna's Eclipse can be used for counter-attacks and interception against gap-closing heroes who use their blinking abilities without protection or who recklessly jump on her, provided that Luna is able to cast it in time. Examples include: Queen of Pain_new, Riki, Phantom Assassin, Faceless Void and pretty much any hero who relies on Blink Dagger to close the gap.
With Dust of Appearance, Luna will be able to use Eclipse on invisible heroes. Be mindful that Slark is exception because he'll be able to remove the debuff with Dark Pact.
Lucent Beam can be used to cancel channeling abilities or abilities with long cast animations, and can be also used to prevent the escape attempts Town Portal Scroll and/or Boots of Travel.

Moon Glaives can ignore certain abilities that either trigger on attack or give evasion under the condition that the heroes who have them are not primary targets. Examples include: Centaur Warrunner, Windranger, Phantom Assassin, Hoodwink etc.

Luna can easily cancel channeling spells with Lucent Beam and 0.25s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent for Eclipse, she can also buy Abyssal Blade in case they decide to buy Black King Bar: Enigma's Black Hole, Witch Doctor's Death Ward, Shadow Shaman's Shackles, Lion's Mana Drain, Bane's Fiend's Grip, Pudge's Dismember, Crystal Maiden's Freezing Field, Pugna's Life Drain, Dawnbreaker's Solar Guardian, and Naga Siren's Reel In from Aghanim's Scepter.

Even though Black King Bar and other forms of Spell Immunity will block Luna's magical damage output, they will not block Luna's high physical damage, since Luna often goes for items that give her bonus attack damage and attack speed.

Many carries have a hard time against heroes that buy Ghost Scepter and Ethereal Blade because most of them rely on dealing huge amounts of physical damage in order to be effective. However, items and abilities that turn the user ethereal are useless against Luna because even though they will prevent her from attacking them, she can still use Lucent Beam and Eclipse's magical damage to inflict damage to them. Additionally, Eclipse and Lucent Beam will deal enormous damage, especially when Luna farms Aghanim's Scepter and Aghanim's Shard, and she often uses her magical damage in order to kill heroes, which means that Luna is one of the heroes who does not need Nullifier in order to attack enemy heroes that turn themselves ethereal. Luna can also buy Revenant's Brooch to attack ethereal units and amplify the magical damage they will take from Lucent Beam and Eclipse

Illusions created from Manta Style are normally fragile, and Luna will easily destroy them. One should avoid building Manta Style against Luna unless one has natural illusions (Mirror Image etc) or illusion-related abilities (e.g. Mana Break).
Luna can put Linken's Sphere on cooldown using Lucent Beam, although it would be wise to take -4s talent for Lucent Beam for popping Linken's Sphere.
Luna's Eclipse is useful for intercepting heroes who teleport with Town Portal Scroll and/or Boots of Travel. She can also use Lucent Beam to prevent the escape attempts with it.

Even though Blink Dagger can be used to jump on Luna and take her out before she can do anything, an ill-positioned and ill-timed Blink Dagger will render it's owner an easy target for Luna to intercept with Eclipse.

entries.name: Abaddon
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Abaddon bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Mist Coil and Aphotic Shield can help Luna survive bad engagements and hold her own on lane during the laning phase.
Curse of Avernus can silence enemy heroes and boost Luna's attacks against them if Abaddon can successfully land a hit that will trigger it.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Abaddon before and after he uses Borrowed Time.

entries.name: Alchemist
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Alchemist bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase, which is necessary for him due to his low damage output in the early game.
Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Alchemist land a Unstable Concoction on a fleeing enemy hero with minimal risk.
Corrosive Weaponry will increase Lucent Beam's stun duration and help Luna and Alchemist to keep the fleeing enemies in their range.

Alchemist can cast Berserk Potion (requires Alchemist to buy Aghanim's Shard) on Luna, to give her benefits of Chemical Rage by applying a basic dispel on her and giving her attack speed, movement speed and health regeneration on her.
Alchemist can farm Aghanim's Scepter and grant it to Luna so that she doesn't have to.

entries.name: Ancient Apparition
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Ancient Apparition stun the enemy hero with his Cold Feet and hit him/her with Ice Blast.
Lunar Blessing can give Ancient Apparition bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Lucent Beam and Chilling Touch can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.
Ice Vortex can amplify damage from Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Ice Blast nullifies any healing enemy heroes affected by it receive, and allows Luna to finish them off with Eclipse much easier.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Anti-Mage bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase while Mana Break can burn mana from enemy heroes, preventing them in retaliating against Luna and Anti-Mage during ganks.
Lucent Beam can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Anti-Mage to freely use Mana Void on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Anti-Mage before and after he initiates with Blink, which when combined with Counterspell can almost completely discourage enemies from even trying to fightback against Anti-Mage and Luna.
Both, Luna and Anti-Mage are common wielders of Manta Style, which allows them to push waves of creeps, summons, illusions and take down towers very quickly.

entries.name: Axe
lines: Berserker's Call is a perfect setup for Luna's Eclipse, and multiple heroes affected by Berserker's Call will cause them to suffer great damage from Moon Glaives.
Lunar Blessing can give Axe bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Axe before and after he initiates with Blink Dagger and Berserker's Call.

entries.name: Bane
lines: Lucent Beam can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Bane to freely use his abilities on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.
Lunar Blessing can give Bane bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Enfeeble weakens the enemy hero's attack damage, healing and cast range, giving Luna easier time laning against them during the laning phase.
A well-timed Nightmare can be a good setup for Eclipse.
Fiend's Grip can help Luna finish off fleeing enemy heroes with Eclipse.

entries.name: Batrider
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Batrider bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase, which is necessary for him due to his very low damage output in every part of the game.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Batrider before and after he initiates with Blink Dagger and Flaming Lasso.
Lucent Beam can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Batrider to freely use Flaming Lasso on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Bloodseeker
lines: Lunar Blessing combined with Bloodrage can give Bloodseeker bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Rupture forces an enemy hero affected by it to either hold still and be an easy target for Eclipse or to get themselves killed by fleeing while affected by Rupture
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse combined with 0.25s Eclipse Lucent Ministun talent can be a good setup for Blood Rite and the other way around.
Lucent Beam can be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Bloodseeker to freely use Rupture on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Bounty Hunter
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Bounty Hunter bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.

Track gives Luna true sight over the affected enemy hero and bonus movement speed, which allows her to finish them off with Eclipse while also giving her bonus gold if the enemy hero affected by Track is killed.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Bounty Hunter before and after he initiates with Shadow Walk. Likewise Aghanim's Shard upgraded Shadow Walk allows him to cast it on Luna to help her either escape from enemy heroes or to prepare a nasty surprise to the unsuspsecting enemy heroes.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Lucent Beam and Viscous Nasal Goo can be used to help both, Luna and Bristleback catch up and finish off fleeing enemy heroes.
Moon Glaives and Quill Spray can very easily clear waves of creeps, summons, illusions and towers.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Bristleback before and after he goes to wreak havoc with Quill Spray, Warpath and Hairball from Aghanim's Shard.

entries.name: Broodmother
lines: Lunar Blessing combined with Insatiable Hunger can give Broodmother bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase. It can also help Broodmother and her Spiderlings destroy waves of creeps and towers faster when combined with Moon Glaives.
Silken Bola slows and blinds enemy heroes while also making them suffer extra magical damage, which allows it to amplify the damage of the Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Spinner's Snare from Aghanim's Scepter can be a solid setup for Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse.

entries.name: Clinkz
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Clinkz bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and to push enemy towers.
Since Clinkz often buys Gleipnir, he can use it to root multiple enemy heroes at once, and help Luna to finish the fleeing enemy heroes faster with Eclipse.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing combined with Strafe, Tar Bomb, and Burning Barrage from Aghanim's Shard can easily clear waves of creeps, summons, illusions, towers and enemy heroes alike.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Clinkz before and after he initiates with Skeleton Walk.

entries.name: Crystal Maiden
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Crystal Maiden bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Arcane Aura allows Luna to spam Lucent Beam more frequently.
Frostbite and Crystal Nova helps to chase heroes.

entries.name: Dark Seer
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Dark Seer bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Dark Seer before and after he initiates with Blink Dagger, Vacuum and Wall of Replica.
Ion Shell combined with Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can make a short work out of enemy creeps, summons, and illusions.

entries.name: Dawnbreaker
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Dawnbreaker bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Luminosity can heal Luna if she is on low HP and if Dawnbreaker can successfully land a hit that will trigger it.
Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Dawnbreaker's initiations with Solar Guardian.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Dawnbreaker before and after she initiates with Solar Guardian.

entries.name: Dazzle
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Dazzle bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Poison Touch can help Luna finish off fleeing enemy heroes. Aghanim's Shard upgraded Poison Touch can also prevent enemy heroes from retaliating against Luna and Dazzle.
Shallow Grave can help Luna survive bad engagements and give her extra time to retreat and recover.
Shadow Wave can heal Luna while damaging any enemies near her.
Bad Juju can give Luna bonus armor every time Dazzle casts a spell while weakening armor near enemies.

entries.name: Death Prophet
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Death Prophet bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Silence can prevent enemy heroes from using spells on Luna in attempts to counter-initiate against Luna.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing combined with Exorcism can make a short work out of enemy creeps, summons, illusions and towers.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Death Prophet before and after she initiates with Exorcism and Shadow Blade.

entries.name: Disruptor
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Disruptor bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Kinetic Field is a good setup for Eclipse.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Disruptor before and after she initiates with Blink Dagger, Kinetic Field and Static Storm. This can become even better if Disruptor also has Aghanim's Scepter which will allow Static Storm to mute items.

entries.name: Drow Ranger
lines: Lunar Blessing and Marksmanship can give both, Luna and Drow Ranger bonus attack damage to help each other farm during the laning phase and fight against enemy heroes during teamfight.
Moon Glaives and Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Marksmanship can easily clear the waves of creeps, summons and illusions.
Gust prevents enemy heroes from using their abilities on both, Drow Ranger and Luna, and allow Luna to use Eclipse on them with minimal risk.

entries.name: Elder Titan
lines: Luna's Lunar Blessing along with Astral Spirit can give Elder Titan enormous damage for basic attacks.
Echo Stomp and Earth Splitter can significantly disable enemy heroes, allowing Luna to easily kill them with Luna's Eclipse.

entries.name: Ember Spirit
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Ember Spirit bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Ember Spirit before and after he initiates with Fire Remnant and Sleight of Fist.
Searing Chains can keep enemy hero in place, and allow Luna to finish them easier with Eclipse.

entries.name: Enchantress
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Enchantress bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Nature's Attendants can help Luna recover her lost health.

Since Enchantress often buys Hurricane Pike, she can use it either to help Luna escape from bad engagements or to help her chase and finish off fleeing enemy heroes. Likewise, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Enchantress before and after she initiates with Hurricane Pike and Sproink (requires Enchantress to buy Aghanim's Scepter).

entries.name: Enigma
lines: Luna's Moon Glaives combined with Lunar Blessing can help Enigma and his Eidolons push against waves of creeps and destroy towers quickly.

Eclipse combined with Black Hole can quickly finish off enemy heroes before they get a chance to retailiate. This can become even better once Luna buys Aghanim's Scepter that will significantly upgrade Eclipse's damage output, cast range and cause the beams from Eclipse to appear twice as fast.

entries.name: Faceless Void
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Faceless Void bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Chronosphere is an excellent setup for Luna's Eclipse as it prevents the affected enemies from acting, even if they are spell immmune.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Faceless Void before and after he initiates with Time Walk and Chronosphere.

entries.name: Gyrocopter
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Gyrocopter bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Moon Glaives combined with Flak Cannon can make a short work out of enemy creeps, summons and illusions.
Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Gyrocopter's initiations with Call Down.

entries.name: Hoodwink
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Hoodwink hit the enemy hero with her Sharpshooter.
Hoodwink's Bushwhack is a very good setup for Luna's Eclipse.
Since Hoodwink often buys Gleipnir, she can use it to root multiple enemy heroes at once, and help Luna to finish the fleeing enemy heroes faster with Eclipse.
Lunar Blessing can give Hoodwink bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Hoodwink before and after she initiates with Scurry and Bushwhack.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Huskar bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Huskar's initiations with Life Break.

entries.name: Jakiro
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Jakiro hit the enemy heroes with his Ice Path, Macropyre and Dual Breath combo.
Lunar Blessing can give Jakiro bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Eclipse and Macropyre can often kill enemy heroes will little problems, especially when both abilities are upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can help Jakiro push lanes of creeps and towers with ease when combined with Liquid Fire and Liquid Frost (requires Jakiro to buy Aghanim's Shard).

entries.name: Keeper of the Light
lines: Chakra Magic can sustain Luna's mana pool and give her unexpectedly very low cooldown (up to 0 seconds) nuke, especially in early game. Heal from Illuminate is very useful as well.
Solar Bind can amplify the damage of the Lucent Beam and Eclipse while slowing the enemy hero more he/she moves while affected by it.
Will-O-Wisp (requires Keeper of the Light to buy Aghanim's Scepter) can be a very good setup for setup for Luna's Eclipse.

entries.name: Legion Commander
lines: Eclipse combined with Lunar Blessing can help Legion Commander win Duels.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Legion Commander before and after she uses Duel.
Lucent Beam can also be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Legion Commander to freely use Duel on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Lifestealer bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Infest is a great ability to prepare a surprise on enemy heroes who try to gank Luna.

Since Lifestealer himself cannot stun enemy heroes on his own without Abyssal Blade, Lucent Beam is a great ability to help him catch up with the fleeing enemy heroes. Likewise, Lucent Beam can also be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Lifestealer to freely use Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Infest on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.
Open Wounds (requires Lifestealer to buy Aghanim's Shard) can help Luna recover herself with both, direct attacks and Eclipse.

entries.name: Lina
lines: Though Light Strike Array has small area-of-effect, it can be somewhat of a solid setup for Eclipse.
Lina will greatly benefit from Lunar Blessing as that means she can deal bonus attack damage when she has lots of stacks from Fiery Soul.
Lucent Beam can also be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Lina to freely use Laguna Blade on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.

entries.name: Lycan
lines: Lunar Blessing combined with Feral Impulse can give Lycan very high attack damage needed for fighting and pushing.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Lycan before and after he uses Shapeshift to wreak havoc on enemy heroes.

Lycan can cast Wolf Bite (requires Lycan to buy Aghanim's Scepter) on Luna to give her benefits of Shapeshift. Be mindful however, that Wolf Bite will reduce Luna's attack range if casted on her since the unit affected by Shapeshift will be melee.

entries.name: Mars
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Mars hit the enemy heroes with Spear of Mars.
Lunar Blessing can give Mars bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Mars's initiations with Arena Of Blood.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Mars before and after he initiates with Arena Of Blood.

entries.name: Medusa
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Medusa bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase, which is very necessary for Medusa due to the damage reduction from Split Shot.
Moon Glaives and Split Shot can make a short work out of enemy creeps, summons and illusions.
Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Medusa's initiations with Stone Gaze. Stone Gaze can also amplify all the physical damage Luna can inflict on enemy heroes affected by Stone Gaze.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Medusa before and after she initiates with Stone Gaze.

entries.name: Meepo
lines: Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Meepo before and after he initiates with Poof.
Lunar Blessing can give Meepo bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Meepo hit the enemy heroes with Earthbind.

entries.name: Monkey King
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Monkey King bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Monkey King before and after he initiates with Primal Spring and Wukong's Command.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: A well-timed Song of the Siren can be a very good setup for Luna's Eclipse or to help her escape ambushes and heal herself when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
Lunar Blessing can give Naga Siren bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase. It can also help Naga Siren destroy waves of creeps and towers faster when combined with Moon Glaives.
Ensnare and Reel In (requires Naga Siren to buy Aghanim's Scepter) can help Luna finish off fleeing heroes with Eclipse or to escape from bad engagements.

entries.name: Nature's Prophet
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Nature's Prophet bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase. It can also help Nature's Prophet and his Treants summoned from Nature's Call destroy waves of creeps and towers faster when combined with Moon Glaives.
Sprout can help Luna finish off fleeing heroes with Eclipse or to escape from bad engagements.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Nature's Prophet before and after he uses Teleportation and Shadow Blade.

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Necrophos bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Death Pulse helps Luna hold her own on lane during the laning phase.

Even though Death Seeker (requires Necrophos to buy Aghanim's Shard) can prevent Luna from attacking enemy heroes with her Moon Glaives and direct attacks, it can greatly amplify damage of Lucent Beam and Eclipse. Death Seeker can also be used on Luna to help her escape from heroes who rely on physical damage. However, it is not advised to use Death Seeker for defense against heroes who rely on magical damage.

entries.name: Night Stalker
lines: Eclipse causes day to become night, triggering Night Stalker's Hunter in the Night for the ten extra seconds of nighttime.

Dark Ascension gives both of them long vision range. Alternatively, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse, can be casted on Night Stalker before he starts fighting against enemy heroes while affected by Dark Ascension.

entries.name: Omniknight
lines: Purification combined with Heavenly Grace can save Luna from certain death in most of the situations.
Guardian Angel will allow Luna to freely initiate with Eclipse while giving her protection against enemy attacks and all other ablities that deal physical damage.

entries.name: Oracle
lines: Even though Oracle's Fate's Edict can prevent Luna from attacking enemy heroes with her Moon Glaives, it can give her 100% spell immunity, which may potentially save her from bad engagements.
Oracle's Fortune's End allows him to dispel Luna from negative effects, or to dispel and root enemies, making them easier target for Eclipse.
False Promise combined with Purifying Flames can often save Luna from a certain death.

entries.name: Pangolier
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Pangolier bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Pangolier before and after he initiates with Swashbuckle, Shield Crash and Rolling Thunder.

entries.name: Phoenix
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Phoenix bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Phoenix before and after he initiates with Icarus Dive or when he uses Supernova to restore himself. Likewise, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Supernova can be casted on Luna to restore both, Luna and Phoenix back to full health and mana.
Sun Ray can heal Luna and help her hold her own on lane while dealing damage to enemies.

entries.name: Pudge
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Pudge hook an enemy hero with Meat Hook. Likewise, Meat Hook can also be used to save Luna from bad engagements.
Lunar Blessing can give Pudge bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Dismember can help Luna finish off fleeing enemy heroes with Eclipse. Aghanim's Shard upgraded Dismember can also be used to save Luna and help her recover her health.

entries.name: Pugna
lines: Even though Pugna's Decrepify can prevent Luna from attacking enemy heroes with her Moon Glaives and direct attacks, it can greatly amplify damage of Lucent Beam and Eclipse. Decrepify can also be used on Luna to help her escape from heroes who rely on physical damage. However, it is not advised to use Decrepify for defense against heroes who rely on magical damage.
Lunar Blessing can give Pugna bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Pugna finish off fleeing enemy heroes with Life Drain.
Nether Blast combined with Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can easily clear waves of heroes and destroy towers with little problems.
Nether Ward can discourage enemy heroes from using abilities in attempts to counter-initiate against Luna.

entries.name: Queen of Pain
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Queen of Pain bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Lucent Beam and Shadow Strike can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Queen of Pain before and after she initiates with Blink, and Sonic Wave.

entries.name: Razor
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Razor steal lot of attack damage from enemy heroes with Static Link. Alternatively, Lucent Beam can also be used to put Linken's Sphere on cooldown and allow Razor to freely use Static Link on a hero who tries to protect himself/herself with Linken's Sphere.
Lunar Blessing can give Razor bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and while Static Link is unavailable for Razor to use.
Eclipse and Eye of the Storm can often kill enemy heroes will little problems, especially when both abilities are upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can help Razor push lanes of creeps and towers with ease when combined with Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Riki
lines: Smoke Screen prevents enemy heroes from using abilities on Luna and it can also cause their attacks to miss while in it.
Lunar Blessing can give Riki bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Riki before and after he initiates with Blink Strike and Tricks of the Trade. It can also be casted on him while he is under effects of Cloak and Dagger.

entries.name: Sand King
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Sand King bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and while Sand Storm is unavailable for Sand King to use.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing combined with Sand Storm can easily clear waves of creeps, summons and illusions.

Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Sand King before and after he initiates with Blink Dagger, Burrowstrike and Epicenter. Likewise, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be also casted on Sand King while he is invisible within Sand Storm's radius.

entries.name: Shadow Demon
lines: Disruption can create powerful illusions of Luna that also possess her Moon Glaives, allowing for safe and fast tower pushing. Disruption can also be a good setup for Eclipse.
Demonic Purge and Lucent Beam can often stop the wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.

entries.name: Shadow Fiend
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Shadow Fiend bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and to gain stacks for Necromastery. Lunar Blessing combined with Presence of the Dark Lord and lots of stacks for Necromastery can give huge attack damage to Shadow Fiend.

Eclipse can be a good followup for Shadow Fiend's initiations with Requiem of Souls. And since Shadow Fiend commonly buys Arcane Blink, Silver Edge and Wind Waker, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Shadow Fiend before and after he initiates with Requiem of Souls.

entries.name: Shadow Shaman
lines: Shackles can help Luna either escape from an enemy hero who is pursuing her or to finish off the fleeing enemy hero.
Lunar Blessing combined with Mass Serpent Ward can often quickly push waves of creeps and destroy towers with little problems.

entries.name: Slark
lines: Lunar Blessing can provide Slark bonus damage and night vision for teamfights and ganks.
Eclipse triggers night, allowing Slark to take advantage of his superior night vision and the enemy's reduced vision to initiate or escape.
Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Slark leash escaping enemy heroes with Pounce.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Slark before he jumps on enemy heroes with Pounce.

entries.name: Snapfire
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Snapfire bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.

Firesnap Cookie can heal Luna, help her either escape from enemy heroes or close the distance and stun nearby enemy heroes. Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Snapfire before and after she initiates with Firesnap Cookie.
Mortimer Kisses and Eclipse can often make a short work out of enemy heroes.
Scatterblast and Lucent Beam can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.

entries.name: Spectre
lines: Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Spectre before and after she initiates with Haunt or Shadow Step (requires Spectre to buy Aghanim's Scepter).
Lunar Blessing can give Spectre bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.
Lucent Beam and Spectral Dagger can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.
Moon Glaives can clear waves of creeps, summons and illusions, and allow Spectre to trigger Desolate more often.

entries.name: Spirit Breaker
lines: Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Spirit Breaker before and after he initiates with Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
Lunar Blessing can give Spirit Breaker bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and to help him fight against enemy heroes during teamfights.

entries.name: Sven
lines: Lunar Blessing combined with God's Strength can give Sven bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase and to fight against enemy heroes.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Sven before and after he initiates with Blink Dagger and Storm Hammer or with Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Storm Hammer.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing combined with Great Cleave can easily clear waves of creeps, summons and illusions.
Warcry can give Luna bonus armor during the teamfights, for she is very frail and cannot endure a lot of beating if she gets focused.

entries.name: Treant Protector
lines: Nature's Grasp can help Luna finish off fleeing enemy heroes. Alternatively, Lucent Beam's stun can help Terant Protector slow the enemy heroes with Nature's Grasp.
Leech Seed can heal Luna and her nearby allies while damaging the hero affected by it.
Living Armor can heal Luna and give her bonus armor.

Eclipse can be used as a good follow-up to Treant Protector's initiations with Overgrowth. Alternatively, Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Treant Protector while he is affected by Nature's Guise.

entries.name: Venomancer
lines: Lucent Beam and Venomous Gale can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.
Lunar Blessing combined with lots of Plague Wards can often quickly push waves of creeps and destroy towers with little problems.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Venomancer before and after he initiates on enemy heroes with Poison Nova.

entries.name: Vengeful Spirit
lines: Vengeance Aura can improve Luna's attack range and damage. Early-game, she can set up kills as well as use Nether Swap on Luna to allow her escape from a sticky situation and potentially save her life.
Lunar Blessing can give Vengeful Spirit bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase.

entries.name: Visage
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Visage and his Familiars bonus attack damage to help them farm during the laning phase and push towers faster.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Visage before and after he uses Silent as the Grave (requires Visage to buy Aghanim's Scepter).
Grave Chill seriously slows down enemy heroes, allowing Luna to finish them off with Lucent Beam and Eclipse.
Moon Glaives allows Luna to help Visage and his Familiars clear waves of creeps, summons, illusions.

entries.name: Void Spirit
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Void Spirit bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Void Spirit before he initiates on enemy heroes with Astral Step.

Aether Remnant and Lucent Beam can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing. Aether Remnant can also provide vision on the affected enemy hero when upgraded with Aether Remnant provides 475 True Sight talent, allowing Luna to finish them off with Eclipse.

entries.name: Weaver
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Weaver bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
The Swarm armor reduction can amplify the damage from the Moon Glaives on the heroes affected by it.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Weaver before he starts chasing enemy heroes with Shukuchi.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Time Lapse can often save Luna from a certain death.

entries.name: Wraith King
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Wraith King bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Moon Glaives allows Luna to help Wraith King and his Skeletons summoned from Vampiric Spirit clear waves of creeps, summons, illusions and towers.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse can be casted on Wraith King before and after he counter-initiates with Reincarnation.
Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Reincarnation can give Luna extra time to finish off enemy heroes during teamfights before dying.
Wraithfire Blast and Lucent Beam can often stop wounded enemy heroes from fleeing.

entries.name: Zeus
lines: Lunar Blessing can give Zeus bonus attack damage to help him farm during the laning phase.
Lightning Bolt gives ture sight over the enemy that is struck by it, allowing Luna to use Eclipse against them.
Arc Lightning combined with Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can make a short work out of enemy creeps, summons and illusions.

Heroes that can help Luna disable foes in the early-game to kill or flee from: Crystal Maiden, Shadow Shaman, Rubick, Earthshaker, Sven, Alchemist, Bane, Outworld Destroyer, Shadow Demon, Pudge, Bristleback, Hoodwink, Lion, Nyx Assassin, Ogre Magi, Grimstroke, Doom etc.

Heroes to help maintain Luna's health, especially in the early-game: Omniknight, Io, Phoenix, Dazzle, Warlock, Enchantress, Abaddon, Winter Wyvern, Necrophos, Oracle, Dawnbreaker, Treant Protector, Witch Doctor etc.
Heroes with damage amplification: Slardar, Drow Ranger, Pugna, Blood finding, Shadow Fiend, Shadow Demon, Ancient Apparition, Elder Titan.

Heroes who can push towers or waves of creeps will benefit greatly from Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing: Lina, Pugna, Jakiro, Keeper of the Light, Broodmother, Naga Siren, Shadow Shaman, Death Prophet, Lycan, Visage, Razor with Aghanim's Scepter, Venomancer, Meepo, Enigma, Holy Knight, Nature's Prophet, Warlock, Phantom Lancer, Terrorblade etc.

Heroes who lack strong disable or have no strong disable on their own (unless if they choose to build disabling items) or have difficulties landing them will benefit from Luna stunning fleeing enemy heroes with Lucent Beam: Razor, Viper, Clockwerk, Weaver, Ursa, Mirana, Leshrac, Blood finding, Hoodwink, Jakiro, Troll Warlord.

Heroes who can either initiate to put all heroes in one place for Luna to use Eclipse or who can follow up with Luna after she uses Eclipse: Earthshaker, Axe, Sven, Tidehunter, Pantheon, Faceless Void, Sand King, Spectre, Enigma, Dawnbreaker, Lina, Naga Siren, Shadow Fiend, Death Prophet, Elder Titan, Shadow Shaman, Dark Seer, Monkey King, Omniknight, Batrider, Disruptor, Snapfire, Void Spirit, Ember Spirit, Earth Spirit, Storm Spirit, Pangolier, Grimstroke, Crystal Maiden, Magnus etc.

If she has Aghanim's Scepter. Luna can use Eclipse on heroes who can jump and wreak havoc: Earthshaker, Axe, Sven, Tidehunter, Pantheon, Faceless Void, Dawnbreaker, Weaver, Sand King, Bounty Hunter, Riki, Slark, Clockwerk, Legion Commander, Templar Assassin, Enigma, Spectre, Batrider, Alchemist, Ursa, Disruptor, Pangolier, Night Stalker, Void Spirit, Ember Spirit, Earth Spirit, Storm Spirit, Mirana, Anti-Mage, Magnus, Phantom Assassin etc.
Overall, Luna works well with lots of heroes.
Gleipnir can root multiple enemies at once, and prevent them from escaping the Eclipse.
Desolator becomes more effective when it's owner is affected with Lunar Blessing.
Blink Dagger combined with Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eclipse is a very good way to initiate a teamfight.
Wind Waker can be a good setup for Eclipse when timed correctly.
Ethereal Blade can greatly amplify the damage from Eclipse.
Gem of True Sight and Dust of Appearance can greatly help Luna against enemy heroes who rely on invisiblity to escape from Eclipse.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch gives some good starting attributes and can be built into Magic Wand later.

entries.name: Circlet
lines: Circlet gives good starting attributes and builds into Wraith Band.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango gives Luna some starting health regeneration, allowing her to trade hits with enemies in lane.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve allows Luna regenerate almost her entire health pool in the early game.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand is good on most heroes in order to get some bonus burst health as well as bonus stats.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed are core on any hero for extra move speed in order to chase and to escape.

entries.name: Town Portal Scroll
lines: Town Portal Scroll is helpful to quickly enter fights from across the map. Luna is one of the carries that can turn the tide of battle thanks to Eclipse.

entries.name: Power Treads
lines: Power Treads increase attributes and attack speed to increase Luna's damage output.

entries.name: Dragon Lance
lines: Dragon Lance is among the most cost-effective items in the game, providing strength and agility at a reasonable price. The range increase is particularly nice on Luna since her own range is low and she has no mobility tools to help her get in reach of enemies except her high movement speed. The item is also useful for early-mid game pushing and fighting.

entries.name: Manta Style
lines: Manta Style is the core item in most games on Luna giving her damage, health, and bonus move speed. Since Manta Style's illusions obtain Moon Glaives passive, they are useful for pushing and increasing damage output.

entries.name: Mask of Madness
lines: Mask of Madness helps Luna farm neutral and lane creeps with increased movement speed, attack speed, and lifesteal. Disassemble in the late game to build Butterfly and Satanic.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter will greatly increase the effectiveness of Eclipse as it will allow Luna to cast Eclipse either on an allied unit and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. It will also increase total beams and duration, remove the limit on beams per unit, and make the beams appear twice as fast. It is a great item for Luna when her team has a powerful initiator such as Faceless Void and the enemy team has few ways to dodge a long distance Eclipse.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar improves Luna's survivability with spell immunity, countering enemy disables, and giving her bonus strength and damage.

entries.name: Butterfly
lines: Butterfly offers a great mixture of heavy damage and survivability, giving Luna bonus attack speed, damage, armor, and evasion.

entries.name: Satanic
lines: Satanic gives Luna some much-needed survivability, offering Luna a burst heal to live through immense amounts of damage in fights.

entries.name: Hurricane Pike
lines: Hurricane Pike, a situational upgrade of Dragon Lance, provides an escaping and chasing tool for Luna.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will allow Luna to use Moon Glaives as an active ability to create 4 glaives that will rotate around her in a 150 radius for 7 seconds, reducing damage she takes by 25% while also dealing 75% of Luna's Attack Damage to enemies thart collides with a glaives.

entries.name: Monkey King Bar
lines: Monkey King Bar can give Luna great attack speed and damage output while also giving her attacks a chance to pierce evasion.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger improves Luna's abilities to chase down wounded enemy heroes or escape from pursuing enemy heroes. It can also be used for the initiations with Eclipse.

entries.name: Helm of the Dominator
lines: Helm of the Dominator synergizes with Lunar Blessing and gives opportunity to dominate Alpha Wolf to increase her attack damage even more.

entries.name: Witch Blade
lines: Witch Blade will give Luna bonus armor, attack speed and intelligence, and will also increase the projectile speed of Moon Glaives and make them have true strike every 9 seconds. Later it can be upgraded into Parasma that will allow Luna's attacks to weaken magic resistance of enemy heroes, making them more vulnerable to Lucent Beam and Eclipse's magical damage output.

entries.name: Eye of Skadi
lines: Eye of Skadi will provide Luna with great attribute bonuses, which also benefit illusions, and the slow effect will keep enemies within Luna's attack range.

entries.name: Daedalus
lines: Daedalus will give Luna a great amount of bonus attack damage and will allow Moon Glaives to deal critical strikes to enemies.

entries.name: Silver Edge
lines: Silver Edge can give Luna great attack speed, chance to deal critical strikes, escaping mechanism and will also allow her to apply a break on an enemy hero that gets attacked by it.

entries.name: Linken's Sphere
lines: Linken's Sphere can give Luna the ability to block all the single-targeted abilities, especially spell-immunity piercing ones. If Luna combines it with Black King Bar, her survivablity will improve drastically.

entries.name: Disperser
lines: Disperser can give Luna very high attack damage, as well as good points of agility and intelligence, and will allow Moon Glaives to burn mana of enemy heroes, making it very useful against heroes who rely on mana like Medusa. Disperser will also allow Luna to slow down enemy heroes to keep them in range of Eclipse and to dispel either herself or her allies and make them unslowable.

entries.name: Abyssal Blade
lines: Abyssal Blade's bash will proc often thanks to Luna's high attack speed even if she is ranged hero. Abyssal Blade also allows Luna to stun an targeted enemy hero even if they are spell immune and will also provide her with damage block.

entries.name: Bloodthorn
lines: Bloodthorn will give Luna great amount of attack speed, attack damage, intelligence, and will also provide her with health regeneration, mana regeneration and magic resistance. Bloodthorn will also allow Luna to silence an enemy hero, preventing them from dodging Eclipse and will cause Moon Glaives to have true strike on the silenced target while passively allowing Luna's attacks to weaken enemy spell damage.

entries.name: Radiance
lines: Radiance will give Luna great attack damage along with another way of damaging multiple enemies at once if Moon Glaives get disabled by Break, and will also give her good damage output and evasion.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos will give Luna bonus health and intelligence, allowing her to withstand more damage and use her abilities more often, and will also allow her to root an enemy hero to keep them in her attack range and in range of Eclipse. Later it can be upgraded into Gleipnir that can root multiple enemy heroes at once, and allow Luna's attacks to trigger chain lightning that can bounce between multiple enemies and damage them.

entries.name: Gleipnir
